title: Choose Pricegent's first visual direction
question: The Android-first study app will turn supplied material into explanations and connected knowledge. Choose the visual system for its first working slice.

options.label: The Study Folio
options.lineage: Annotated textbooks, study guides, and handwritten margin notes
options.thesis: A familiar study desk turns supplied material into a guided, revisit-able learning path.
options.viewport: An Android study home puts the next learning action first, then a recent project and saved studies.
options.risk: Paper cues can feel nostalgic unless the app's digital actions stay crisp and accessible.

raised.raise: Keep source disagreements and uncertainty visibly distinct instead of flattening them into one answer.
Make prerequisites and learning progression legible before advanced concepts.
Keep destructive edits isolated from routine study actions.
Make saved topics easy to scan, with clear status and a useful next action.

options.label: The Concept Atlas
options.thesis: Turn a topic into a map of ideas, with prerequisites and relationships shown as navigable routes.
options.viewport: A learner's home leads from a new study action into a highlighted topic map, where each relationship is a legible route.
options.risk: Map language can imply certainty unless evidence and uncertainty remain explicit.

options.label: The Grid Specimen
options.thesis: A visible grid makes concepts and their hierarchy feel exact and easy to compare.
options.viewport: A study dashboard uses a quiet construction grid to separate the new-material action, concept hierarchy, and recent work.
options.risk: The grid can become a rigid aesthetic rather than a helpful learning structure.
options.case: Its discipline improves hierarchy and comparison, though the atlas connects concepts more naturally.

options.label: The Learning Route Board
options.lineage: Boarding passes and live departure boards
options.thesis: A learning route makes the next concept and a changed understanding easy to spot.
options.viewport: The home screen pairs a clear next-step route with a live-looking list of saved study projects and their progress states.
options.risk: Travel-board language can make learning feel like a queue instead of an exploration.
options.case: Its persistent state changes clarify learning progress, but the atlas better expresses conceptual relationships.

options.label: The Evidence Overlay
options.lineage: Darkroom exposure records and translucent print sheets
options.thesis: Separate evidence layers keep conflicting claims visible instead of blending them together.
options.viewport: A study report layers source claims and marks an unresolved conflict without hiding the explanation.
options.risk: Darkroom notation is too specialized to orient a broad learning audience.
options.kept: Keep uncertainty and source conflicts distinct and traceable.

options.label: The Growing Field Guide
options.lineage: Botanical field guides and seasonal plates
options.thesis: Concepts unfold from foundations toward advanced understanding in visible stages.
options.viewport: A study project shows prerequisite concepts before advanced ideas and marks what the learner has explored.
options.risk: Botanical imagery can narrow an app meant for every subject.
options.kept: Show prerequisite and advanced concepts as a real learning progression.

options.label: The Dark Knowledge Console
options.thesis: Persistent panels keep study material, extracted concepts, and actions in view together.
options.viewport: A compact analysis workspace places supplied notes beside extracted definitions and concept links.
options.risk: Developer-console conventions do not fit the broader learning audience.
options.kept: Separate consequential edits from routine actions with clear spacing and confirmation.

options.label: The Study Shelf
options.lineage: Streaming catalog shelves and title cards
options.thesis: A scannable shelf makes it quick to resume a saved topic or start another.
options.viewport: The home screen groups saved studies by recent activity and exposes a clear resume action.
options.risk: A media catalog can make knowledge feel like content to browse rather than ideas to understand.
options.kept: Make saved studies scannable and easy to resume.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Use a familiar, well-executed study dashboard with no distinct visual-world commitment.
canonCard.viewport: A conventional dashboard gives the new-study action, recent projects, and saved library clear priority.
canonCard.risk: It will be easy to use but harder to recognize and remember.
